name: Melanie Klein
shortBio: Austrian-British psychoanalyst who founded object relations theory, pioneered child play analysis, and conceptualized the paranoid-schizoid and depressive positions.
centralQuestion: How do early phantasized relations with internal part-objects and unconscious splitting mechanisms structure the infant's psychic life, primal anxiety, and capacity for reparation?

keyWorks.title: The Psycho-Analysis of Children
keyWorks.description: Seminal work establishing play technique as child psychoanalysis and charting early superego formation.

keyWorks.title: Mourning and its Relation to Manic-Depressive States
keyWorks.description: Defines the depressive position, whole-object relations, and the reparative drive.

keyWorks.title: Envy and Gratitude
keyWorks.description: Articulates innate constitutional envy as a destructive force against the good object, counterbalanced by gratitude.
